chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Opening night: missing his entrance and leaping down four flights
summary: After the crap game scene he was upstairs when the stage manager forgot to call him, and Helen Dowdy yelled that he was on; he jumped four flights.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: However, we do the song, I get the downbeat, I think it was on "Ain't Necessarily So," that this downbeat was given and I didn't take it on time. And from then on we did that, the rehearsal come down great. And after rehearsal, the night of rehearsal, the next day was the opening. And on the opening night everybody was thinking that John Bubbles ain't going to make it. They thought I would miss all my parts and everything, you know? Well, I had all -- I could do the whole show. They didn't know that. So -- I could do everybody's part in the show. So when the time come for the curtain to go up, everybody was saying, "Good

luck! Good luck! Good luck!" and the overture is playing and everybody is greeting each other, telling good luck and all, and when the curtain went up for the first part of the show I was in the first scene, which was a crap game scene, I'm going to do this scene, and I did the scene and got it out of the way. Then I go upstairs, 'cause I gotta come down and do another scene, 'cause I'm all through the show as Sportin' Life and I go upstairs to freshen up, put some happy dust in my hat and put some-cool off, relax, and while I'm up there the stage manager forgot to call me. So they almost passed my scene before one of the girls, called the strawberry girl, Helen Dowdy, was coming upstairs which she was dressing up on the floor over me, and saw my door open, and she hollers, "Sportin' Life, you're on." And I said, "How'm I doin'?" thinking she was kidding me. So I go to the door and she says, "You're on!" I jumped down the first flight of stairs and the second -- four flights I had to jump down, four flights of
stairs going down. Each one was a landing, you know. So I didn't take time to count the steps, I just jumped this distance.
